tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// bshags pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ che ge mo zhes bgyi ba bdag las nyon mongs pa dang*/ mi shes pa dang*/ bag med pa dang*/ ma gus pa dang*/ snyoms las kyi dbang du gyur pas rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba bgyis pa dang*/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang*/ dam tshig ma dag pa dang*/ tshogs 'dres pa dang*/ spyod yul gcig par gyur pa dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa la ma brtson pa dang*/ srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams dus dus su ma mchod cing ma gsol ba'i dbang gis/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig chags nyams su gyur pa dang*/ khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa thams cad spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas/ thugs rje dang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dam pa khyed rnams la mthol lo bshags so// bzod par gsol lo// mkha' la sprin dengs pa'am/ rgya mtsho la rlabs zhi ba ltar/ nongs par spyad pa dang*/ de'i 'bras bu thams cad med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di dang*/ rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'dis/ dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi thugs dam skong bar gyur cig bzhed pa grub par gyur cig re ba rdzogs par gyur cig de ltar gyur nas kyang*/ bdag gi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dgra dang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang*/ dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod// dges pa chen po'i sgo phye nas// dngos grub phrin las bdud rtsi yi// rgyun gyis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod// dpal mgon po lcam dral gyi bshags pa 'phags pas sbyar ba'o//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
